scope: Pure display-only SVG typography; no source maps, IDs, snapshots, shared families, contracts, registry or UI changes

api.function: typesetArithmeticGeometrySvg(svg: string, options?: { normalizeLabel?: (label: string) => string }): string
api.callBoundary: Root facade calls after trusted saved-pack validation, then applies its presentation sizing marker
api.normalization: Root supplies Korean polygon/polyhedron name normalization. Original wording stays in data-original-label; typeset groups also retain aria-label and data-label metadata.
api.sizing: Adapter preserves actual viewBox, width, height, original coordinates, anchor, rotation and all geometry. Root owns 280px longest-extent/responsive sizing.

engine.conventions: Exact MathJax TeX glyph paths and measured editor metrics; uppercase points and words roman; lowercase variables italic. Plain physical units/powers/fractions are normalized into explicit editor TeX. CJK remains visible in the original fallback font, using the editor's 1em mixed-label advance and thin-space convention.
engine.runtime: fflate synchronous decode plus prebuilt glyph/layout dictionary; no MathJax, DOMParser, Node/Python imports, HTML or foreignObject in SVG
engine.unknowns: Unknown vocabulary, rich positioned tspans, unsupported text layout/style or complex CSS remain unchanged and visible. Already typed engine groups skip unchanged.

verification.browser: Chromium standalone bundle, no Node globals or runtime MathJax; zero page errors
